name: nuvio
description: Nuvio Streaming TV - Native Android/iOS app with Rust SDK

scripts.ios:build: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace NuvioTV.xcworkspace -scheme NuvioTV -sdk appletvsimulator -configuration Debug build
scripts.ios:build:release: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace NuvioTV.xcworkspace -scheme NuvioTV -sdk appletvos -configuration Release archive -archivePath build/NuvioTV.xcarchive
scripts.ios:test: cd ios && xcodebuild test -workspace NuvioTV.xcworkspace -scheme NuvioTV -sdk appletvsimulator -destination 'platform=tvOS Simulator,name=Apple TV'
scripts.ios:clean: cd ios && xcodebuild clean -workspace NuvioTV.xcworkspace -scheme NuvioTV
scripts.ci:validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.build:all: npm run rust:build && npm run android:build && npm run ios:build
